name: claude-skills
description: A collection of custom Claude Code skills, each installable as its own plugin.

plugins.name: suno-songwriter
plugins.description: Compose original Suno AI songs as copy-paste-ready prompts (lyrics, style, titles).

plugins.name: hand-off
plugins.description: Delegate a scoped chunk of work to a fresh Claude Code subagent with full context preserved.

plugins.name: pr-comment-triage
plugins.description: Triage and resolve PR review comments end to end, then reply under each original comment.

plugins.name: github-doc-sync
plugins.description: Keep a GitHub project's README, in-repo guides, and wiki in sync with code changes.

plugins.name: skill-validator
plugins.description: Validate SKILL.md files against Anthropic's structural requirements.

plugins.name: github-actions-security-review
plugins.description: Audit and harden GitHub Actions workflows against the OWASP GitHub Actions Security Cheat Sheet.
